scope: Independent read-only source comparison and targeted node tests. No browser, physical touch or screen-reader claims. No production edits by reviewer.
reviewed: Placement regions exclude entire card pool, settlement, dock, own trigger and details-access button; upper chrome may still be overlaid.
Escape suppression includes pending, hovered and focused anchors and cancels pending timers.
Pointer travel and internal scrolling retain read access; text reading suppresses game shortcuts.
Enter/Space on focused item anchors prevent native activation during passive reading; native browser QA by owner remains separate.
Native dialog blocks game shortcuts, scrolls and allows selection, restores eligible focus on close.
Notice-only rendering preserves open dialog; committed state or target change closes it.
captureWorkbenchPosition excludes body-level dialog content, so notice-only rendering has no scoped app focus to steal.
Transactions remain routed through original act/save; inspection changes UI only.
All changed affix labels agree with views.js shared descriptions.

findings.issue: Passive text selection could leave item anchor focused and native Enter/Space could click it unless default prevented.
findings.status: Source prevention added by tooltip owner before reviewed version; native-input assertion assigned to owner.
